people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise Yah!
translations.bsb: He has raised up a horn for His people, the praise of all His saints, of Israel, a people near to Him. Hallelujah!
translations.kjv: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.
translations.asv: And he hath lifted up the horn of his people, The praise of all his saints; Even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye Jehovah.
